title: Describe a Past Community Event
instructions: Speak about a real or imagined weekend activity, then use feedback to improve your original recording.
prompt: Describe a real or imagined event you attended. Explain where you went, what people did, one problem, how someone helped, and what you learned. Use past forms and speak for about 75–105 seconds.
reference: Last Saturday, I went to a music event in the city park with a friend. At first, a girl was sad because the sign had fallen down. A volunteer brought paper, and we made a new sign together. I carried the sign to the gate while my friend helped visitors find the stage. We watched a performance and talked to a bus driver during his break. We did not swim in the lake because the water was cold. Before leaving, we collected the unused badges. I learned that a small job can make an event easier for everyone. Next time, I would arrive earlier to help prepare.
